plugins.name: borgiq-builder
plugins.description: Build BorgIQ workflows from Claude Code. Hub skill (actor wiring, triggers, expressions) plus four focused spokes: form-builder (interface pages & forms), react-app-builder (Vite/React app UIs), agent-builder (AI agents, agent-harness, MCP), json-schema-builder (structured data contracts). Lifecycle slash commands: /validate, /new-actor, /deploy, /test, /debug-flow.
